journal: Journal of the Japan Petroleum Institute 57(3), 125-132 (in Japanese)
experimental_method: Equilibrated gas-water mixture in a cell at 60 C with stirring (3 h); 1 microlitre samples of gas phase and of water phase taken through a sampling valve and analysed by gas chromatography (Porapak-N, TCD) for CH4, CO2 and water, calibrated against standards.
uncertainties_stated: Coefficients of variation of 3 repeats are tabulated (CH4 0.7-4.9 %, CO2 0.1-1.2 % per text; table lists 0.8-4.9 and 0.1-1.3); agreement with literature within 4 % (CH4) and 2 % (CO2); temperature and pressure uncertainties not stated.
quality_remarks: Paper is in Japanese; table captions are English. Method-development paper; Table 3 is the only table of measured solubility. Gas-phase water content is not reported. T in table varies 59.8-60.6 C around nominal 60 C.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2 (check valve effect, GC peak areas of CO2 and water): raw detector peak areas, not solubility data
extraction_notes: Table typed from the text layer and compared cell by cell with the 200 dpi page image; all 19 rows matched. Sanity: CO2 solubility rises with P along the pure-CO2 series; pure-CH4 series rises with P.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean, every cell matched the page image
